pr_body:
When parsing provider requirements we should check the type of the source and version attributes rather than assuming that they are strings. Otherwise an invalid attribute value will cause a panic.

(Probably best reviewed ignoring whitespace.)

Fixes #25366

Thanks for reporting this crash! There's a PR fixing it at #25369.

The underlying problem here is that your configuration is using single quotes instead of double quotes for strings. This is not valid HCL. If you switch to double quoted strings, hopefully you should be able to make some progress.
